## Checklist

- [ ] Canonical data updated; DOI/arXiv/preprint duplicates checked.
- [ ] Title, year, status, authors and code provenance verified or uncertainty explicit.
- [ ] Direct/context/transfer scope is appropriate; no unsupported performance claim.
- [ ] Annotation is original and relevant corrections are included.
- [ ] `validate.py`, `build.py --check` and offline tests pass.
- [ ] Generated files included; no PDFs, secrets, trackers or unrelated changes.
